claim: Efficient exploration reduces the number of expensive DFT evaluations, and the cost of LLM reasoning is negligible compared to DFT calculations.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by measuring the computational cost of LLM reasoning versus DFT evaluations in a given materials search task.

conditions: CO adsorption on Cu-surface adatoms and M–N–C catalysts
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the specific DFT and LLM systems used; the cost trade-off may differ for other simulation methods or LLM models.

title: Efficient exploration–Number of DFT evaluations boundary
